responsibility: Generated format-definition header for the BRIG frontend’s on-disk HSA BRIG binary representation. It mirrors the HSAIL/BRIG 1.0.1 specification by declaring the fixed-width enums, offsets, flags, and packed record layouts for module headers, directives, instructions, operands, and data blobs that make up BRIG sections. The rest of the `brigfrontend` uses these type and structure definitions as the canonical schema when reading raw BRIG bytes, decoding section entries, interpreting opcode- and operand-specific fields, and navigating intra-module offsets during BRIG-to-GENERIC translation.
